# agentseam

> The primitives layer for every coding agent — one handler API over per-agent hooks,
> instruction files, plugin packaging, and config.

Every coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Windsurf,
and more) invented its own hook system, instruction-file convention, and permission
language. agentseam normalizes them into one handler API, one decision type
(`allow`/`deny`/`escalate`/`transform`/`warn`/`vouch`, aligned to the Agent Control Standard;
`ask` and `rewrite` remain as deprecated aliases of `escalate` and `transform`), and an
explicit capability matrix that states what each agent can *actually* enforce — `enforced`,
`best-effort`, `enforceable`, `detect`, or `none` — rather than assuming they are equivalent.
A matrix row is only claimed when a `verified: {version, date, method}` record backs it;
most rows rest on vendor documentation and are marked as such, not on an observed live run.

License: Apache-2.0. Status: pre-1.0 — the CLI surface, manifest schema, and compiled
output can change between MINOR releases.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/README.md): what it is, the
  capability matrix, install, supported agents.
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): the
  layering principle (agentseam / chock / chock-catalog), the four primitives, and the bug
  classes the design exists to prevent.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): per-version
  changes, one entry per user-visible behavior change.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how
  to add an agent adapter, the honesty rule that overrides preference, and local checks.
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/SECURITY.md): threat model
  and how to report a vulnerability.

## Examples

- [examples/generated/](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/tree/main/examples/generated):
  a page per supported agent, showing the same scenario in that vendor's own dialect —
  config, normalized event, and decision — generated from the real code paths.
- [tools/VERIFY.md](https://github.com/open-coder-ai/agentseam/blob/main/tools/VERIFY.md):
  how to capture your own agent's real payloads and turn a `vendor-docs` matrix row into a
  `live-run` one.
